1 · Intro

When to use it.

Payroll costing decides which account pays for a person's compensation, and for which periods. It matters for grant and contract research and for certain gifts.

Blank costing on an assignment is not an error. It means the default applies.

Use this whenYou need to decide whether an employee needs costing entered or can stay on the default.

2 · Walk through

How Oracle picks the account, then your decision.

Check off each item as you read.

Watch-outs

  • Some departments set default costing at the work unit level, others at the business unit level. Know which applies to you.
  • Costing touches payroll and financial reporting. Wrong costing charges the wrong budget.
  • Costing practice varies by department. Validate with your finance partner.

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1An assignment has no costing. What happens?

Q2In what order does Oracle look for costing?

Q3Your department splits the work unit by program code. What happens if you don't enter costing?

HCM Academy job aid · Costing Management

Costing fundamentals

Use when: You need to decide whether an employee needs costing entered or can stay on the default. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. When payroll runs, Oracle checks three levels in order:
    • Is the pay element costed? Use the element's costing (for example, a bonus charged differently).
    • If not, is the assignment costed? Use the assignment's costing.
    • If not, use the default for the assignment's work unit.
  2. Open the employee's assignment and check its costing.
  3. Blank? Salary charges to the work unit's default COA (for example, work unit 46100, program 000).
  4. Ask your finance partner: does your department split the work unit by program code (for example, Team A = 100, Team B = 200)?
    • No split: leave the default. Nothing to enter.
    • Split: enter costing for each person. Otherwise they default to program 000.
  5. Ask whether finance wants any role tracked separately. If yes, enter costing with the COA they give you.

Watch-outs

  • Some departments set default costing at the work unit level, others at the business unit level. Know which applies to you.
  • Costing touches payroll and financial reporting. Wrong costing charges the wrong budget.
  • Costing practice varies by department. Validate with your finance partner.
